How do I use it properly the very first time?
To use your porch swing properly and safely for the first time, keep these key setup steps in mind:
1. Proper Height & Clearance: Hang the swing so the seat is about 18 to 24 inches off the floor. Make sure you have at least 6 inches of clearance on either side and about 24 inches of clearance in front and behind it for a smooth, unobstructed swing path.
2. Check Your Ceiling Joists & Hardware: Ensure your swing hangers or mounting hooks are anchored directly into solid, load-bearing ceiling joists or structural beams capable of supporting the combined weight of the swing and occupants. Make sure all hardware, chains, or ropes are securely fastened.
